test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jul, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which group primarily benefits from the Stand-Up India Scheme?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Women and SC/ST entrepreneurs**__.
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 

__ 
 
• The **Stand-Up India Scheme** was launched by the **Government of India on April 5, 2016**, with the objective of promoting **entrepreneurship among women and Scheduled Castes (SC) and Scheduled Tribes (ST)**. 
 
• The scheme primarily provides **bank loans ranging from Rs. 10 lakh to Rs. 1 crore** to at least one Scheduled Caste (SC) or Scheduled Tribe (ST) borrower and one woman borrower per bank branch for setting up a greenfield enterprise. 
 
• The enterprise could be in the sectors of **manufacturing, services, agri-allied activities, or trading**. The main aim is to encourage economic participation from these underrepresented groups. 
 
• The scheme is implemented through all branches of **Scheduled Commercial Banks (SCBs)** across India, ensuring widespread accessibility. 
 
• It also provides **handholding support** by facilitating guidance, mentorship, and assistance with registration and other requirements. 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 

__ 
 
• **Eligibility Criteria:** 
 
 
• The applicant must be a **woman or belong to the SC/ST category**. 
 
• The age of the borrower must be **above 18 years**. 
 
• The loans are specifically for **greenfield projects**, i.e., the first-time venture of the beneficiary in manufacturing, services, or trading sectors. 
 
• The borrower should not be in default to any bank or financial institution. 
 
 

 
• **Loan Details:** 
 
 
• The loan amount ranges from **Rs. 10 lakh to Rs. 1 crore**. 
 
• The scheme provides a **composite loan** (inclusive of term loan and working capital) for setting up an enterprise. 
 
• The repayment period for the loan is up to **7 years**, with a maximum moratorium period of 18 months. 
 
 

 
• **Support System:** 
 
 
• The scheme includes a dedicated portal (**Stand-Up Mitra**) that offers handholding support and connects borrowers with banks and other stakeholders. 
 
• Mentorship and guidance are provided to help applicants with technical and financial expertise. 
 
 

 
• **Achievements:** 
 
 
• Since its inception in **2016**, the scheme has supported thousands of women and SC/ST entrepreneurs in setting up their businesses. 
 
• It has contributed significantly to **financial inclusion** and the empowerment of marginalized communities in India. 
 
 

 
• **Comparison with Other Schemes:** 
 
 
• Unlike schemes like **Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana**, which focuses on micro-enterprises, the Stand-Up India Scheme specifically targets women and SC/ST entrepreneurs for medium-scale businesses. 
 
• It also ensures **social equity** by addressing the economic challenges faced by these groups. 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
 

 
 
• **Key Data:** As of **March 2023**, more than **1.5 lakh beneficiaries** have been sanctioned loans under the Stand-Up India Scheme, with a significant proportion being women entrepreneurs. 
 
• **Sectoral Focus:** The scheme encourages innovation and entrepreneurship in sectors like **manufacturing, services, and agriculture-allied activities**, driving economic growth in rural and urban areas. 
 
• **Inclusivity:** The focus on SC/ST and women entrepreneurs highlights the government’s commitment to **social and economic empowerment** of marginalized groups in India.
